That sentence must use the child's words (the word સુંદર coming back, the આ... આ... drawl, the line that returns after every કડી) and must name no device: પુનરાવર્તન, ધ્રુવપંક્તિ, ટેક, પ્રાસ, અલંકાર, સજીવારોપણ and છંદ are all barred as labels.

No rhyme scheme may be asserted for this poem. The કડી do not rhyme end to end — સુંદર/ગિરિવર and સુંદર/સમીર share only a final ર, while સુંદર/વિશાળ and સુંદર/માનવ share nothing. The two real, audible echoes are inside the first lines of two કડી — ઉષા–નિશા and ભાષા–આશા. Where nothing chimes, say nothing (reference/no_hallucination_policy.md).

The refrain is taught once and referenced after. વિભુ હશે તો કેવા સુંદર, એવું થાતું મુજ મનમાં is printed in full five times with no word changed, so it lives in M1.S1.T1 only and the other four topics carry it through `depends_on`. M1.S2.T2 … M2.S3.T5 may spend at most one sentence on the line coming back, must not re-explain વિભુ, હશે or મુજ, and must not quote it into their own `original_chunk`.

The poem wonders; it does not ask. વિભુ હશે તો કેવા સુંદર carries no request and no આજ્ઞાર્થ verb, and 01_meta.json records પ્રાર્થના-કાવ્ય as tested and ruled out for this chapter. No field may turn the refrain into a prayer, a vow, or a lesson about ઈશ્વર; it is one person wondering out loud in front of something beautiful, and it stays that (global_content_rules.md rule 10).

The sung third of the lens is prescribed by the page, not optional: the blue પ્રવેશપેટી orders આ કાવ્યનું પઠન અને ગાન અનેક વાર કરાવવું and the exercises close on આ કાવ્યનું વર્ગમાં સમૂહગાન કરો.
